name: Foot Fetish Fortress VolTitan Vs. The Jundoh Empire Vol.2
source:
The 2nd part of the 6 part  series

Follow Marvin's journey in this super robot action-comedy where he's been recruited to wield VolTitan! A  giant, bionic foot fetish powered  War-God, and defend the planet  Feeternia against the Jundoh Empire a puritanical galactic empire bent on making humanity their bitches with their army of giant monsters. 

Story

 After a series of numerous defeats the Jundoh Empire scientist Dr.J decides to his new weapon J-Buster the polymorphic wonder will VolTitan be able to meet the challenge find out in this exciting sequel.

[From [url=https://voltitandev.itch.io/foot-fetish-fortress-voltitan-vol2]Itch.io[/url]]

6部分系列的第2部分

在这部超级机器人动作喜剧中跟随马文的旅程，他被招募来使用VolTitan！一个巨大的仿生恋足癖者为战神提供动力，并保卫费特尼亚星球免受Jundoh帝国的侵害，Jundoh帝国是一个清教徒式的银河帝国，一心用他们的巨型怪物军队让人类成为他们的母狗。

 经过一系列的无数次失败后，Jundoh帝国科学家Dr.J决定使用他的新武器J-Buster，多态奇迹VolTitan将能够迎接这部激动人心的续集中发现的挑战。
